context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay subscription E2E flow fully tested. Key endpoints verified: GET /api/razorpay/config (returns key_id, enabled status), POST /api/razorpay/create-order (creates Razorpay order), POST /api/razorpay/verify-payment (rejects invalid signatures as expected - LIVE keys can't simulate real payments), GET /api/razorpay/debug/subscription-renewal/{uid} (shows remaining days calculation), GET /api/razorpay/payment-history/{uid} (shows all payments), POST /api/razorpay/update-order-status (updates cancelled/failed orders). Admin manual activation skipped because test user has no email. Frontend subscription page shows Elite plan with 74 days remaining.
